issues.detail: The skill file contains excessive padding and verbose sections that reduce conciseness.

scenarios.name: audit-activation-flow
scenarios.rationale: Both responses omit all required sections of the rubric.

scenarios.name: mobile-permission-onboarding
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes a decision table and a new flow, but lacks lifecycle messages, event specs, experiment design, and the required seven‑section Markdown structure, whereas Response A provides no relevant content.

scenarios.name: experiment-onboarding-flow
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items (primary metric, sample size, guardrail, event spec) but lacks a detailed screen list and decision table; Response B includes more planning details but omits key flow, decision table, base rate, target, and guardrail.
